# Degree of a Vertex in an Undirected Graph

#### Course: DSA with C++

## Degree of a Vertex in an Undirected Graph

The degree of a vertex is the number of edges connected to it.

Consider the graph below:

![An Undirected  Graph](data:image/png;base64,)

Here, the degree of vertex 1 is 2 because two edges are connected to it.

![Degrees of Vertices in an Undirected Graph](data:image/png;base64,)

Now, let's look at the degrees of the other vertices:

| Vertex | Degree |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | 2 |
| 2 | 2 |
| 3 | 3 |
| 4 | 1 |
| 5 | 0 |
